reason: This plugin is primarily a chat interface layout optimization: it is a DSH web plugin that injects CSS to the chat conversation list to enable native `content-visibility:auto` behavior on message nodes, reducing rendering work for off-screen items. The plugin’s stated goal and implementation are focused on UI performance in long conversations rather than analytics, data processing, integrations, or automation.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 的聊天列表优化插件，通过给会话消息节点注入 `content-visibility: auto` 样式，降低长会话滚动中的离屏渲染开销。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness chat list optimization plugin that injects styles for conversation message nodes using `content-visibility: auto` to reduce off-screen rendering work during long-chat scrolling.

capabilities: Injects client-side CSS for DeepSeek Harness web conversations
Applies `content-visibility: auto` to chat message nodes to reduce off-screen render/layout/paint work
Uses `contain-intrinsic-size` for scroll/anchor stability with skipped rendering
Targets only the chat list rendering path without changing message data logic

reasons.code: Repository description and README state the plugin is a DSH chat performance plugin enabling browser-native content-visibility:auto for chat list nodes.
README provides the exact injected selector and CSS declarations, including `[data-chat-flow] > [data-chat-anchor-key] { content-visibility: auto; contain-intrinsic-size: auto 320px; }`.
Package manifest declares a DSH web client plugin with a client patch and web platform injection target.
